title: af/storage-prune@2
description: `af storage prune --json` (ADR-0144): what one sweep removed, or without --apply would remove. Collection first (rule `collection`), then the budget, least recently used first (rule `budget`), until the total fits `max_bytes` or nothing else may be removed (`stop`). Gate cleanups of finished Tasks are those the sweep tried; registry entries whose path holds no Store any more are dropped; a failed removal is listed and tried again by the next sweep. Version 2 adds the removal kind `survey` (ADR-0152 clause 13): a Survey's record in its Project Store's CAS, its `path` the CAS object, taken behind a `SurveyCollected@1` tombstone by collection beyond `[storage] keep_surveys`, by the budget, or, rule `recovery`, by a sweep that finishes what an interruption left between a tombstone and its deletion. A Survey whose record's bytes were no Survey is removed with `unreadable`, the reason its tombstone carries; a Survey collection chose in a Project Store whose `project.lock` a refresh or a plan holds is listed under `held`, by the preview and the applied sweep alike, and never removed; a Survey whose record cannot be reached without a link or read is a failure, and keeps its record and its place in the log.

unreadable.description: A `survey` removal only: why its record's bytes were no Survey, as its `SurveyCollected@1` tombstone says.

held.description: Entries collection chose and left because a lock holds them: the Surveys of a Project Store a refresh or a plan holds (ADR-0152 clause 13). The next pass tries again.
